meta.note: Corridors as first-class risk entities. p0 = reasoned 30-day base rate prior; signals = BAKED snapshot of the mid-2026 posture (news/ais/sanctions/market each 0..1, normalized). Live mode (RA5) replaces the snapshot; the fusion math is identical. 2026-07-26: the HORMUZ row alone was re-assessed to the US-Iran war regime (p0 + all four signals); the other four corridors are unchanged from the 2026-07-16 snapshot and the weights are untouched.

news.note: log-odds per unit signal; news leads physical events (GDELT literature)

ais.note: behavioral signal: dark ships / reroutes / transit deviation

corridors.name: Strait of Hormuz
corridors.p0_basis: war-regime prior, 2x the 0.04 peace-regime rate. The 0.04 held because Hormuz never closed in 40 years of incidents (Tanker War 1984-88, 2012 threats, 2019 seizures); an active US-Iran exchange changes the reference class to interdiction episodes, which recur weekly-to-monthly and outlast the 30-day horizon (shortest on record: 2019, 90d). CAPPED at 0.08 by the RA3 plausibility bound - a higher prior puts expected shortfall over 50% of India's imports, contradicting C1 (India is a solvent price-taker: barrels reroute, they do not vanish).
corridors.signals_basis: baked snapshot 2026-07-26, US-Iran war: PULSED interdiction - intermittent closure/reopening, the 1984-88 tanker-war signature at higher tempo. news 0.95 = closure/attack reports at critical severity; ais 0.80 = transits collapsing with AIS gaps; sanctions 0.55 = shadow-fleet surge; market 0.90 = war-risk premiums at ceiling. CAVEAT carried from the corpus: 6/6 prior Iran/Hormuz episodes ended WITHOUT a sustained closure, and attack-only episodes moved crude -10% to +5% while supply-LOSS episodes moved it +45% to +150% - this number is disruption probability over 30 days, not a closure forecast.

corridors.name: Bab el-Mandeb
corridors.p0_basis: reasoned prior: active attack era since 2023 (Red Sea crisis)
corridors.signals_basis: baked snapshot: convoy escorts extended, transits ~-40% vs baseline, freight premiums elevated

corridors.name: Suez Canal
corridors.p0_basis: reasoned prior: downstream of Bab el-Mandeb pressure + 2021 grounding precedent
corridors.signals_basis: baked snapshot: southbound convoy volumes down ~18% (news rail)

corridors.name: Strait of Malacca
corridors.p0_basis: reasoned prior: piracy incidents, no state-level closure threat

corridors.name: Cape of Good Hope
corridors.p0_basis: reasoned prior: open-ocean route, weather risk only — it is the fallback, not a chokepoint
corridors.signals_basis: baked snapshot: elevated traffic from Red Sea reroutes (congestion, not threat)
